blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Police arrested two suspected drug dealers during a buy-bust operation in Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro, on Saturday, Oct. 10. The Sablayan Municipal Police Station said its Municipal Drug Enforcement Team conducted the operation at 1:25 p.m. in Barangay Santo Niño, in coordination with other police units and the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Mimaropa. The suspects were identified only by their aliases, “Edwin” and “Edmon,” both 32 and residents of Barangay Santo Niño.
